title.zh: 翻转二极管，看电流走哪条路
title.en: Flip a Diode on the Bench

brief.zh: 先合开关，跟着电流标记绕一圈。换到第二组，保持开关闭合，只翻转普通二极管，观察红灯。
brief.en: Close the switch and follow the current markers around the loop. In the second case, keep the switch closed, flip only the ordinary diode, and watch the red LED.

concept.zh: 闭合回路与二极管的方向
concept.en: A complete loop and diode polarity

label.zh: 比较二极管的两个朝向
